correctness.rationale: The binary cylinders 00 and 11 give A=[[0,1],[1,1]], B=[[1,1],[1,0]], so N_n=1^T product M_j 1 and Lebesgue mass N_n/2^(n+1). Each disjoint pair AA or BB doubles the column-one vector; total selected pairs ≥ceil(d_n/2), yielding N_n≥2^(1+ceil(d_n/2)). Cutting at each equal neighboring pair gives d_n+1 alternating matrix blocks; AB and BA are triangular unipotents, their length-ell maximal row sum is ell+1, and AM-GM yields N_n≤2(1+n/(d_n+1))^(d_n+1). The limiting function t log(1+1/t)→0 proves both limsup and liminf iff statements without claiming a universal entropy limit. Bit-flip conjugacy transforms perfect alternation to forbidden 01, giving exactly n+2 monotone words. Independent direct itineraries across every schedule through n=10 verified counts and integer inequalities. All claims are specific to those two holes, not arbitrary holes.
residual_risks: Finite tests alone do not prove infinite claims; source proof reconstructed and critical steps checked analytically.
